Home / Our Story

It started with a simple question: What if things could work better?

The story of Unisale Systems is rooted in a passion for building technology and exploring the possibilities of automation.

An interest in possibilities.

Technology is more than code, computers or digital interfaces. It is an opportunity to rethink how things work.

The ability to turn an idea into a working product, simplify repetitive tasks and solve everyday problems is what makes technology exciting.

That interest in building and improving things became the foundation of Unisale Systems.

From an idea to a company.

Founded in October 2026 by Collins Gitonga, Unisale Systems was established with a clear ambition: to build practical digital products that solve real problems.

Rather than focusing on technology for its own sake, the company set out to develop solutions that people and businesses could actually use.

Our first step: Unisale POS.

Every technology company begins somewhere. For Unisale Systems, one of its first major steps is Unisale POS.

Designed to simplify business operations, Unisale POS brings essential business management capabilities into one platform.

It represents the company's belief that well-designed software can make everyday business processes easier and more efficient.

Our story is still being written.

Unisale Systems is being built with a global perspective.

Our ambition is to continue developing useful products, exploring new opportunities and applying technology to problems that matter.

The journey is only beginning.

Collins Gitonga

Founder, Unisale Systems
